extDesc.message: Automatically clicks buttons when a countdown timer reaches zero. Per-site profile support.

optTimerSelectorHelp.message: CSS selector of the element containing the countdown

optTimerTargetHelp.message: Button clicks when timer reaches this value (e.g. 00:00)

optPreActionHelp.message: Element to interact with before clicking the button (radio, checkbox, dropdown)

optButtonSelectorHelp.message: CSS selector of the button to click

optButtonTextHelp.message: Text to search for in button (e.g. Next, Continue, Submit)

optPickerActive.message: Click an element on the page...

guideStep1Desc.message: Open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click 'Load unpacked' and select the extension folder.

guideStep2Desc.message: Right-click the extension icon and open 'Options', or click 'Profile Settings' in the popup. Start with the New Profile button.

guideStep3Desc.message: Enter the website address where automation should run. E.g.: *://adbs.uab.gov.tr/* The asterisk (*) means any text.

guideStep4Desc.message: If the page has a countdown, enable 'Has countdown timer?'. Enter the timer CSS selector or use 'Pick from Page'. Set the target value (usually 00:00).

guideStep5Desc.message: Enter the CSS selector of the button to click, or a text match (Next, Continue, Submit etc.). If both are provided, the selector is tried first.

guideStep6Desc.message: If a checkbox must be checked or a dropdown selected before clicking the button, fill in the pre-action section.

guideStep7Desc.message: Right-click any element on the page and choose 'Inspect'. The element is highlighted in the panel. Right-click it and choose Copy > Copy selector.
